reviews.title: Another great Thermalright product.
reviews.comment: I've owned many Thermalright coolers and this one is among my favorites. It does a great job cooling and is quiet as expected, but I specifically bought it for the display. With Thermalright's software you can configure it to change colors depending on temperature. Since this is on one of my computers that usually has the monitor off, I can easily see from across the room whether it is working or idle by just the color.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Unmatched for the price point and the Airflow.
reviews.comment: Fantastic product, was thinking of r going with an AIO but came across this in my searches, thanks trackers lol. looked a little more into the company and their products saw that they are highly rated and used, saw the LCD screen version and decided this is the one for me with ARGB. perfect for my new build, easy to put together easy to get it working, mounting the fans on to CPU was no issue at all very nice product.
reviews.author: ricanpone529

reviews.title: Very quiet and an exceptional cooler
reviews.comment: The cooler does do a very good job. So far I haven't been able to get the temperature over 50c. The CPU and GPU temperature readouts help and they look nice. The software to utilize the read outs was extremely simple to install. i like this cooler. It works. And it is simple to install. The tdp of the CPU I use is 120 and the cooler does a good job cooling. I prefer this cooling method over liquid cooling.
reviews.author: John P.

reviews.title: Peerless Assassin 120
reviews.comment: If you want the best balance of performance, aesthetics, and price, go with the Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 Digital ARGB. I bought this as a replacement for a a psu I got that was DOA. Glad I made the change
